verdict.rationale: New Relic documents an AI assistant for asking questions about and exploring telemetry in plain language. It also documents an official MCP server that converts plain-English questions into NRQL and returns results, so a natural-language question produces a real query. missing for 10: explicit evidence that a natural-language prompt produces a chart or visualization, in-depth documentation of the NL-to-NRQL behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask questions of my telemetry in natural language and get a real query or chart back

citations.quote: It allows you to ask questions, troubleshoot issues, and explore telemetry data using plain language.
Ask questions in plain English, and the MCP server converts them to NRQL to get results—even if you're not a NRQL expert.
If you're struggling to get a query to work, ask our AI assistant to help you.
